products.name: Royal Crimson Banarasi Katan Silk Saree
products.tagline: Woven with pure gold Kadwa zari flora and royal scalloped border.
products.description: Drape yourself in royal majesty with this authentic Banarasi Katan Silk Saree. Handcrafted by master weavers in Varanasi using pure mulberry silk threads and electroplated antique gold zari, this masterpiece features exquisite floral jaal (Kadwa technique) across the body and a commanding pallu. Ideal for weddings, receptions, and grand festivities.
products.short_desc: Heirloom Banarasi silk draped in regal crimson wine red with intricate gold floral jaal.

products.name: Vaidarbhi Pure Kanjivaram Bridal Gold Silk Saree
products.tagline: Heavy gold brocade with temple korvai border and annapakshi motifs.
products.description: The crowning glory of bridal heritage. This authentic Kanjivaram silk saree is woven with double-warp 3-ply silk and rich 24K gold dipped silver zari. The traditional Korvai weaving connects the contrasting border seamlessly, showcasing regal elephant and Annapakshi mythological bird motifs along the magnificent pallu.
products.short_desc: Majestic Kanchipuram silk with authentic silver-gold dipped zari and contrasting pallu.

products.name: Mayura Peacock Blue & Magenta Korvai Kanjivaram Saree
products.tagline: Vibrant peacock teal body with contrasting rani pink gold brocade border.
products.description: Handcrafted by master silk weavers in Kanchipuram, the Mayura drape features rich 3-ply mulberry silk yarns in luminous teal blue. The hand-linked Korvai weaving connects the rani magenta pink border flawlessly, enriched with gilded gold zari peacocks and temple spires.
products.short_desc: Royal Kanchipuram weave featuring auspicious peacock butis and grand floral pallu.

products.name: Noor Rose Gold Embroidered Organza Saree
products.tagline: Feather-light sheer organza with hand-cutwork scalloped border and sequins.
products.description: Ethereal and mesmerizing, the Noor Organza Saree is crafted from featherlight sheer silk organza in a romantic blush tone. Detailed with meticulous floral bullion embroidery, matte micro-sequins, and a delicate scalloped edge, this saree is a favorite for destination cocktail soirees and engagement celebrations.
products.short_desc: Delicate blush pink sheer organza saree with glistening floral zari threadwork.

products.name: Maharani Pure Paithani Silk Saree with Peacock Pallu
products.tagline: Regal Maharashtra heritage handwoven with tapestry Asawali peacock motifs.
products.description: Step into royal heritage. This heirloom Paithani silk saree took 60 days on the handloom in Yeola. Featuring intricate multi-color tapestry Asawali floral vines along the body and an awe-inspiring royal peacock pallu with pure electroplated gold zari threads.
products.short_desc: Opulent royal purple Paithani saree woven with pure silk and kaleidoscope gold zari.

products.name: Midnight Velvet Sequined Cocktail Saree
products.tagline: Sculptural georgette with micro-shimmer sequins and plush velvet border.
products.description: Turn heads at every gala and cocktail party. This designer georgette drape features high-density micro-sequins embedded into luxurious flowy fabric, finished with an opulent midnight velvet border. Comes with an unstitched heavy designer blouse piece with sweetheart neckline work.
products.short_desc: Sleek midnight black georgette saree featuring dark starry sequin work for evening glam.

products.name: Rajkumari Heritage Sindoor Bridal Banarasi Saree
products.tagline: The ultimate royal trousseau with pure 24k gold zari shikargah motifs.
products.description: Created for the bride who desires an eternal heirloom. This exquisite masterpiece took over 90 days on the handloom. Featuring traditional Shikargah forest animal motifs woven in pure gilded zari across the body, a dense bridal kadiyal pallu, and heavy brocade unstitched blouse.
products.short_desc: Heirloom heavy Banarasi bridal saree in deep sindoor red with rich shikargah hunting scene zari.

products.name: Aarya Hand-Block Printed Mulberry Mulmul Cotton Saree
products.tagline: Featherlight 100-count pure cotton with botanical Bagru vegetable dye prints.
products.description: The epitome of understated elegance. Made from superfine 100s count cotton yarn, this saree breathes easily through long workdays and humid afternoons. Hand-block printed by master artisans in Bagru using natural plant-derived indigo and madder dyes, finished with hand-knotted pom-pom tassels.
products.short_desc: Ultra-soft handspun mulmul cotton saree crafted for breathable all-day office comfort.

products.name: Chandni Handwoven Chanderi Tissue Silk Saree
products.tagline: Moonlit metallic sheen with delicate meenakari butis and zari border.
products.description: Woven with gossamer-fine cotton and silk yarns interwoven with shimmering gold tissue, the Chandni Chanderi Saree captures the radiance of the full moon. Subtle gold zari butas with minute meenakari enamel highlights illuminate the drape, making it effortless for festive dinners and day pujas.
products.short_desc: Sheer golden-ivory Chanderi tissue silk saree woven with subtle metallic threads.

products.name: Sitara Gota Patti Embroidered Georgette Saree
products.tagline: Authentic Rajasthani hand-stitched Gota Patti craft in sunburst marigold yellow.
products.description: Radiate joy at haldi ceremonies and festive pujas. Crafted from premium 60-gram viscose georgette with genuine hand-stitched Rajasthani gota patti applique work, mirror accents, and a rich scalloped border.
products.short_desc: Festive marigold yellow georgette saree embellished with dazzling hand-cut gota motifs.

products.name: Padmavati Antique Gold Zari Jangla Banarasi Saree
products.tagline: Dense all-over antique gold floral jaal on pure handspun katan silk.
products.description: An ode to timeless royalty. The Padmavati Banarasi features an uninterrupted floral Jangla jaal hand-loomed with electroplated antique matte gold zari. The heavyweight pallu displays detailed kalga motifs, draping with imperial stature.
products.short_desc: Regal Varanasi Jangla weave showcasing royal mughal floral vine lattices.

products.name: Arundhati Pure Silver Tissue Muhurtham Kanjivaram
products.tagline: Liquid metallic silver-gold sheen with double-sided korvai border.
products.description: Woven with glistening silver dipped threads interwoven with fine mulberry silk yarn. The Arundhati Kanjivaram reflects light like liquid silver, framed with an antique rose-gold temple korvai border and a rich elephant-peacock pallu.
products.short_desc: Breathtaking silver tissue silk saree designed for modern South Indian brides.

products.name: Bengal Jamdani Handloom Muslin Cotton Saree
products.tagline: Gossamer fine translucent handloom muslin with supplementary weft gold motifs.
products.description: Masterfully woven on manual pit looms in Bengal using 200s count superfine muslin yarn. Each geometric floral buti is placed by hand with a supplementary bamboo spool, creating a whisper-light drape that floats effortlessly.
products.short_desc: Heirloom Dhaka Jamdani weave in pristine off-white with delicate gold zari butis.

products.name: Celeste Metallic Ombre Liquid Satin Saree
products.tagline: Flowy sunset ombre gradient with crystal fringe border detailing.
products.description: Made for modern cocktail soirees and sangeet nights. Crafted from high-sheen liquid satin georgette that cascades with high fluid elasticity, detailed with shimmering micro-crystal tassels along the pallu edge.
products.short_desc: Sleek luxury drape transitioning seamlessly from wine to blush rose gold.

products.name: Samrajni Grand Muhurtham 24K Gold Korvai Kanjivaram
products.tagline: The ultimate royal South Indian bridal masterpiece with pure gold zari.
products.description: The pinnacle of traditional South Indian bridal artistry. Handcrafted by 5th generation weaver families in Kanchipuram with 24K gold dipped silver zari threads, featuring traditional gopuram temple borders and magnificent Annapakshi swans across the commanding 1.2-meter pallu.
products.short_desc: Heavy 3-ply mulberry silk Kanchipuram with dense wedding kalyanam motifs and heavy gold pallu.

products.name: Varanasi Gulab Meenakari Buta Katan Silk Saree
products.tagline: Delicate handwoven rose meenakari motifs with antique kadiyal border.
products.description: A prized masterpiece from Varanasi. Woven on pit-looms using pure 20/22 denier katan silk and antique gold zari threads highlighted with intricate rose enamel meenakari needlework.
products.short_desc: Classic Banarasi silk draped in imperial ruby magenta with colorful meenakari flowers.

products.name: Kamakshi Traditional Temple Korvai Bottle Green Saree
products.tagline: Deep emerald bottle green body with contrasting fiery kumkum red border.
products.description: Woven with high-twist 3-ply mulberry silk, the Kamakshi saree celebrates ancient Dravidian temple architecture with sacred temple spire korvai interlocks along the pallu.
products.short_desc: Heirloom Kanchipuram silk with authentic silver-gold dipped zari and contrasting temple border.

products.name: Mysore Royal Crepe Silk Saree with Pure Gold Zari
products.tagline: Featherlight 100% pure crepe silk with electroplated gold zari kasuti border.
products.description: The pride of Karnataka silk heritage. Made from authentic high-twist mulberry crepe silk threads with certified pure gold zari borders that glide like water over the silhouette.
products.short_desc: Signature royal Mysore drape offering buttery fluid pleats and effortless luxury.

products.name: Zohra Pearl White Hand-Painted Botanical Organza Saree
products.tagline: Artisanal watercolor botanical florals on translucent pure silk organza.
products.description: A canvas of floral poetry. Crafted from whisper-light translucent silk organza, hand-painted with pastel watercolor peonies and finished with a delicate micro-pearl scalloped border.
products.short_desc: Ethereal pearl white organza saree hand-painted by master Kalamkari artists.

products.name: Kutch Organic Handspun Linen Zari Saree
products.tagline: Organic 80-lea Belgian flax linen hand-spun in Kutch with silver tissue pallu.
products.description: Crafted from 100% organic long-staple linen yarn. Breathable, sweat-wicking, and naturally structured, finished with delicate silver zari temple border and tassels.
products.short_desc: Textured earthy luxury linen saree tailored for breathable all-day summer grace.

products.name: Alizeh Shimmer Metallic Pre-Pleated Cocktail Saree
products.tagline: Modern 1-minute ready-to-wear pre-draped silhouette in radiant metallic bronze.
products.description: Slip into red-carpet elegance in 60 seconds. Featuring precision factory-stitched pleats, high-shimmer micro-lamé fabric, and an embroidered crystal belt piece.
products.short_desc: Glamorous pre-pleated designer saree with embellished designer belt for cocktail evenings.

products.name: Shimmer Crimson Wine Georgette Ruffle Saree
products.tagline: Tiered multi-layer organza ruffles along the pallu and border for evening flair.
products.description: Designed for sangeet nights and reception parties. The tiered ruffles add dramatic movement to every step, crafted from fluid 60g georgette with a matching unstitched blouse piece.
products.short_desc: Modern Bollywood-style ruffle saree in rich crimson wine red with mirror belt.

products.name: Jahanara Royal Velvet Zardozi Bridal Masterpiece
products.tagline: Plush mulberry silk velvet with real bullion zardozi and dabka hand embroidery.
products.description: Fit for Mughal queens. Made from rich 9000-grade micro-velvet, embellished by master zardozi craftsmen in Lucknow using gold bullion coils, dabka, and Swarovski crystals over 120 artisan hours.
products.short_desc: Heirloom winter wedding bridal saree in imperial maroon velvet with heavy zardozi border.
